propositions: Standalone file-path execution of reconcile_helpers.py fails with ModuleNotFoundError when _commit_binding_store_snapshot() unconditionally imports git_adapter at line 200, before the documented no-file True branch and fail-open catch execute.
reconcile.py loads reconcile_helpers under a flat key without creating an importable parent rebar_reconciler package, causing the absolute import to fail at module resolution time.

The standalone helper must resolve git_adapter through the existing sibling loader using canonical key rebar_reconciler.git_adapter and file git_adapter.py to preserve documented True/False/error semantics and maintain cache identity with package-context loading.
A package-free by-path load of reconcile.py must call the re-exported binding-store commit helper without ModuleNotFoundError and return the documented boolean contract.
